Positive prefactors, a rational enclosure of the entire contracted interval, the exact equality of the two polynomial derivative routes, 15/15 strictly positive Bernstein coefficients of the degree-14 numerator, and the two 9/9 endpoint certificates jointly support strict convexity and opposite endpoint signs. Continuity and convex secant-slope order then establish a unique interior kernel zero.

claim_decisions.reason: The compact planar convex-hull argument establishes attainment and the general convex/concave envelope description. Strict convexity gives Jensen's unique mono minimizer and the unique endpoint-mixture maximizer for interior means. Endpoint means admit only their own Dirac law. Linearity of the response and the displayed mixtures establish that the whole closed interval is attainable.

claim_decisions.reason: For interior m, the anchored two-line path with v in [m,b] has response k(a)+(m-a)(k(v)-k(a))/(v-a). Strict increase of the fixed-anchor secant slope and continuity cover every value from k(m) to B(m). This proves at-most-two-line attainability; the separate three-line mixture is correctly described as a sufficient construction.

No variance-optimality result follows from this response path.
